confident_novice.statement: Every quadratic graph is a U shape that opens upward.

uncertain.statement: A quadratic probably has something to do with an x squared term.

criteria: The leading coefficient determines whether its parabola opens upward or downward
Roots are x-values where the function equals zero

misconceptions.one_root: Every quadratic has exactly one real root

confident_novice.statement: Mitochondria create energy from nothing for the cell.

uncertain.statement: Cells seem to contain smaller parts with different jobs.

criteria: Mitochondria transform chemical energy into ATP
Cell membranes regulate movement into and out of cells

misconceptions.all_cells_same: All cells contain exactly the same structures
